questions.question: Describe your end-to-end process for a monthly close: how do you plan the calendar, collect inputs, prepare entries and reconciliations, resolve exceptions, and determine that the close is complete?
What would you include in a concise monthly financial reporting package for management, and how would you tailor the commentary for operational department leaders?

A prepaid annual insurance invoice is paid at the beginning of the year. Explain how you would set up the amortization schedule, record the initial entry, post monthly expense, and investigate a difference between the schedule and the general ledger.
